description: Publish what an agent needs (a goal and, optionally, its native payload from any of 40 protocols: chat, CRM, MCP, cloud, energy, payment rails). The Omni-Bridge normalizes it into an AgentIntentNode, Shield screens it, the vault seals it and Sovereign clamps its resource vector before it clears.

goal.description: Plain-language objective, e.g. 'Reserve 12,000 compute units under $47k'.

payload.description: The protocol's native payload, if any.

protocol.description: A registered protocol id (e.g. a2a, mcp, slack, aws-spot) or 'custom'.

source.description: Name of the publishing agent or system.

name: publish_intent
title: Publish an agent intent
